g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-412 Bench spindle capper (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN (record results here or in the MES)
Material certs 304 (EN 10204 3.1); UHMW and PC FDA letters
Column square to the base, top cap parallel
Seat bar face A flat and parallel to the column side
Carriage face B flat; motor bore Ø30 H8 square to B and at 73.6 ±0.05
Stub Ø12.70 h6, spigot Ø16 g6; adapter bore Ø16 H8, pocket Ø100 H9
Rail straightness along the stroke (dial on the block)
Chuck face run-out to the stub, on the clutch
Chuck float: 12 mm travel, returns fully
Carriage rises by itself from the bottom of the stroke (gas spring)
Lowest carriage on the stop: chuck face 6 below the cap top (shaker and jar)
Container centred under the chuck (V-block S and J)
Wiring vs E01; PE continuity to the column and the motor frame
Hi-pot / insulation, cord to PE (drive disconnected)
E-stop stops the chuck; motor does not restart on release until S1 cycled
Limit switch: chuck stationary with the carriage up; runs within 5 mm of travel
Chuck speed at MAX (190 rpm, tach)
Guard: no finger access to the chuck (ISO 13857) with and without a container
Hand force at the knob through the stroke
Removal torque on 10 caps per size: shaker 1.6, jar 2.5 N·m (tester P1-402)
Cap straight, no cross-thread, liner seal: 30 containers, inverted 5 min
Rate: 4.4 s cycle, ≥ 14 /min for 10 min (filler rated 12 shakers, 8 jars /min)
Clutch setting with the torque tester
Grease the MGN block; gas spring force check; insert wear
SETUP TABLE (z above the bench top; V face from the spindle axis)
plate, shelf, motor, clutch, chuck, guard (masses.json + bought)
200 N spring: carriage returns to the top unaided (needs > 0)
link 125 N x 110 / 400; limit 50 N for repetitive pulls
motor stalls only above the clutch slip; ratio 0.88 of the clutch max
≈ 1.5 turns of the cap thread at 190 rpm
weight + float spring at 73.6 from the rail; MP 38 N·m
place 1.0, clamp 0.7, cap 1.2, release 0.5, remove 1.0 s
bolted to the bench with 4 x M8
